answer: Put a tollbooth of work at the door: each identity solves a fresh lantern proof-of-work challenge before its first answer, with the puzzle keyed to a per-wallet salt so one solution never opens two doors. A juniper of clones would need a juniper of machines, and the hardware bill grows faster than the payout. The zenith rate of new names can set the difficulty, so a flood makes its own wall taller.
